title: Diagnose Post-Holiday Sales Weakness
instructions: Analyze the provided store, chain, category, refund, discount, and calendar data. Draft a manager-ready diagnostic that quantifies the decline, ranks drivers, distinguishes evidence from hypotheses, assesses the proposed discount response, and recommends actions with a validation metric. Output: post_holiday_sales_diagnostic.md
criteria: Uses the target and comparison periods correctly.
Attributes the decline primarily to transactions rather than basket value.
Treats post-holiday timing as context rather than unqualified proof of causality.
